SELECT er.RECORD_ID AS RECORD_ID, er.RULE_ID AS RULE_ID, er.SOURCE_SYSTEM AS SOURCE_SYSTEM, er.SOURCE_DOC_TYPE AS SOURCE_DOC_TYPE, er.SOURCE_DOC_ID AS SOURCE_DOC_ID, er.SOURCE_DOC_CODE AS SOURCE_DOC_CODE, er.BIZ_ORG_ID AS BIZ_ORG_ID, org.ORGNAME AS bizOrgName, er.SUBJECT_CODE AS SUBJECT_CODE, sub.SUBJECT_NAME AS subjectName, er.PERIOD AS PERIOD, er.APPLY_AMOUNT AS APPLY_AMOUNT, er.BUDGET_AMOUNT AS BUDGET_AMOUNT, er.AVAILABLE_AMOUNT AS AVAILABLE_AMOUNT, er.CONTROL_RESULT AS CONTROL_RESULT, er.CONTROL_MESSAGE AS CONTROL_MESSAGE, er.EXECUTE_TIME AS EXECUTE_TIME, er.ORG_ID AS ORG_ID, er.CREATE_USER AS CREATE_USER, er.CREATE_TIME AS CREATE_TIME, staff.REALNAME AS createUserName FROM TBL_EXECUTION_RECORD er LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF staff ON er.CREATE_USER = TO_CHAR(staff.STAFFID) LEFT JOIN TBL_ORGANIZATION org ON er.BIZ_ORG_ID = TO_CHAR(org.ORGID) LEFT JOIN TBL_ACCOUNT_SUBJECT sub ON er.SUBJECT_CODE = sub.SUBJECT_CODE
ORDER BY er.EXECUTE_TIME DESC
